title: Microsoft Purview DLP: aggregate alerts by user (Worldwide)
notes: claim 55: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly calls the rule-level alert setting the one documented control for raising DLP alerts, although Learn also documents tenant-level aggregation settings and threshold configuration. The roadmap facts and the printed control path and command are supported, but assurances about reading no new data and having no end-user effect are not documented.

claims.where: Governance controls: first paragraph after table
claims.claim: The rule-level alert setting is the one control Learn documents for how DLP alerts are raised.
claims.quote: This time window is configurable by the admin at the tenant level. ... If you're licensed for aggregated alert configuration options, then you'll see options to generate alerts for each rule match, when thresholds are met, and within a defined time window

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The feature uses no new data source and reads no new data.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview user rule alert aggregation new data source end users impact actions; read roadmap 564765 and dlp-alerts-get-started. These describe grouping rule-match events but do not state that the implementation reads no new data.
claims.fix: Remove 'No new data source:' from Risk assessment and 'and reads no new data' from the risk rationale. Retain the supported statement that the feature groups alert events raised by DLP rules.

claims.claim: The roadmap and Learn describe aggregation as grouping events, not as a new action on users or content.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview user rule alert aggregation new data source end users impact actions; read roadmap 564765 and dlp-alerts-get-started, including the aggregation comparison. No new user/content action is described for this aggregation option.

claims.claim: End users see no change.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview user rule alert aggregation new data source end users impact actions; read roadmap 564765 and dlp-alerts-get-started. Neither states that end users see no change.
claims.fix: Remove '; end users see no change' from the impact rationale. Keep the assessment of the analyst audience and changed alert groupings.

claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor Learn states whether the GA version changes the documented E5 one-minute and E3 15-minute windows.
claims.quote: Searched: "user based" "aggregation" "default" DLP alerts; read roadmap 564765 and dlp-alerts-get-started. Learn states current one-minute/E5 and 15-minute/E3 defaults and labels the user option preview, with no GA-specific change to those defaults.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and At rollout; controls

claims.fix: The Before rollout step checking analyst dashboard roles and Content Explorer Content Viewer membership, and the At rollout step checking tenant aggregation enablement, have no corresponding rows in the controls table. These are the checklist/table omissions; this finding does not request new control rows.
